title: Cartwise Gift Cards Price and Purchase Schedule
content:
The Cartwise Gift Cards range is sold in six card types. This schedule sets, for each card type, the face values a card can be bought for, the fees added to the purchase price, the bulk pricing available to business orders, the card value one purchaser may buy in a calendar day, and who can buy the card and how it reaches them. All amounts are in US dollars.

## Schedule A — Face value and fees

| Card type | Smallest face value | Largest face value | Purchase fee | Fee for mailing a physical card |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cartwise eGift Card | 10.00 | 500.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Cartwise Plastic Gift Card | 25.00 | 200.00 | 0.00 | 3.99 |
| Cartwise Reloadable Gift Card | 25.00 | 500.00 | 0.00 | 3.99 |
| Cartwise Holiday Bonus Gift Card | 50.00 | 250.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Cartwise Corporate Gift Card | 25.00 | 500.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Cartwise Corporate Premium Gift Card | 100.00 | 2000.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |

The mailing fee is the fee for mailing a physical card; it is 0.00 for a digital card or a card taken from a retail rack.

## Schedule B — Bulk pricing and daily purchase limit

| Card type | Cards in one business order for bulk pricing | Bulk discount on the business order | Card value one purchaser may buy per calendar day |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cartwise eGift Card | 0 (not sold in bulk) | 0 percent | 1000.00 |
| Cartwise Plastic Gift Card | 0 (not sold in bulk) | 0 percent | 400.00 |
| Cartwise Reloadable Gift Card | 0 (not sold in bulk) | 0 percent | 1000.00 |
| Cartwise Holiday Bonus Gift Card | 0 (not sold in bulk) | 0 percent | 500.00 |
| Cartwise Corporate Gift Card | 25 | 3 percent | 25000.00 |
| Cartwise Corporate Premium Gift Card | 25 | 5 percent | 50000.00 |

A bulk figure of 0 means the card type is not sold in bulk.

## Schedule C — Who may buy and how the card is delivered

| Card type | Purchase terms |
|---|---|
| Cartwise eGift Card | Bought from a purchaser profile; delivered by email. |
| Cartwise Plastic Gift Card | No purchaser profile needed; sold from a retail rack or by mail. |
| Cartwise Reloadable Gift Card | Bought from a purchaser profile; the card must be registered. |
| Cartwise Holiday Bonus Gift Card | Bought from a purchaser profile; sold during the holiday promotion. |
| Cartwise Corporate Gift Card | Sold on a business order of at least the bulk card count above (25 cards). |
| Cartwise Corporate Premium Gift Card | Sold on a business order of at least the bulk card count above (25 cards), to a verified business account. |

## Notes on reading the schedule

- **Face value range.** A card's face value lies between the smallest and the largest figure of its row, both figures included. For example, a Cartwise Holiday Bonus Gift Card can be bought at 50.00 or at 250.00, but not at 40.00 or at 300.00.
- **Consumer and business types.** Only the two Corporate card types carry a bulk card count and a bulk discount; the four consumer card types show 0 in both columns.
- **Daily figure.** The daily figure is a per-purchaser amount of card value for one calendar day, set per card type.

### Hypothetical comparison (illustrative inputs only)

A business asks about 30 cards. On the schedule, 30 cards meets the bulk card count of 25 for both Corporate card types, so the order qualifies for 3 percent off on the Cartwise Corporate Gift Card and 5 percent off on the Cartwise Corporate Premium Gift Card; the Premium type additionally needs a verified business account and a face value of at least 100.00 per card.
